summary: Backend: 26/26 IMPLEMENTED tests pass — new auth contract (register-with-phone, login/forgot/reset by identifier email OR phone), Krishiva Plus gating (403 for free meera on POST /posts, /messages, /users/{id}/follow — all detail='subscription_required'; 200 for plus ravi), follow toggle, AI multimodal (text + 1x1 base64 jpeg attachment both return real Gemini 3 Flash replies), and full regression (posts/comments/conversations/articles/no-_id-leak). CRITICAL BLOCKER: 5 endpoints referenced by the frontend and mentioned in the spec are 404 on the backend — GET /api/subscriptions/plans, GET /api/subscriptions/me, POST /api/payments/dev-activate, POST /api/payments/order, POST /api/media/start + /chunk + /finish + GET /api/media/{id}. Frontend: verified on 390x800 web preview — login by phone works, feed has NO category chip row, header shows 'Join Plus' pill for free Meera and no CTA for Plus Ravi, FAB opens /create-post which shows Camera + Record + Photo + Video attach buttons (user's reported 'no camera option' bug is FIXED) plus '♻️ Waste Management' category chip (correct label, not 'Waste Mgmt'), profile shows only Posts + Followers stats (NO Level, NO Following cell), labeled 'Log out' button beside 'Edit profile', 'Krishiva Plus active' card for Ravi, Sahayak '+' button opens attach tray with Camera/Photo/Video and text send returns real Gemini reply about jeevamrutha, register screen has Mobile number (10 digits) field, forgot-password accepts email or mobile. HOWEVER free user Meera tapping FAB goes to /subscribe which is stuck on an infinite loading spinner because /api/subscriptions/plans returns 404 — she cannot see the ₹99/₹999 plans, TEST MODE banner or Activate button, so the whole subscription upgrade path is BROKEN from the frontend perspective. YouTube posts show 'React Native WebView does not support this platform' on web preview (expected on web, not a bug).

action_items: MAIN AGENT: Implement missing backend endpoints in server.py — /api/subscriptions/plans (return {razorpay_configured: false, plans: [{id:'monthly', price_inr:99, ...}, {id:'yearly', price_inr:999, ...}]}), /api/subscriptions/me, /api/payments/dev-activate (POST with {plan_id} → sets user.subscription.expires_at), /api/payments/order + /api/payments/verify (Razorpay stubs — return 503 if keys not configured, per the agent-to-agent note), and /api/media/start + /chunk + /finish + GET with Range support. Frontend already calls these paths.
MAIN AGENT: After implementing, re-run /app/backend/tests/test_krishiva_backend.py — the 5 currently-skipped tests will convert to real assertions (they already gracefully skip on 404).
MAIN AGENT: Optionally add a graceful error banner on /subscribe when getPlans() fails so free users are not stuck on an infinite loader forever.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 899 lines — approaching the 700-line soft cap. Recommend splitting into routers/{auth,users,posts,messaging,ai,articles,subscriptions,media}.py.
forgot-password returns the OTP in the response for dev convenience (clearly commented). Must be removed before production.
All Mongo reads use projection {'_id': 0} — confirmed no ObjectId leaks across /auth/me, /users, /posts, /articles, /conversations.
Passwords bcrypt (per-hash salt) and JWT HS256 with configurable expiry — solid.
Follow toggle correctly gates on require_plus(user) — verified 403 for free user.
AI /chat_sync supports images (base64 ImageContent) and video (FileContentWithMimeType from uploads dir) — but the upload path itself is missing, so video is currently unreachable in practice.
